walkthroughs.body_html:
Development of Practical Skills — a core area of A-Level Biology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Development of Practical Skills brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Development of Practical Skills.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Can sucrose move in both directions in the phloem?
options: Phloem always carries sucrose downwards from leaves to roots.
Phloem carries water upwards and sucrose downwards in the same tube.
Yes — translocation goes from any source (e.g. leaves) to any sink (e.g. roots, fruits), so direction varies seasonally and between phloem sieve tubes.

options: It reverses a change in a controlled variable, bringing it back towards the set point.
DNA replication produces two identical fully new molecules with no original material.
